literal_meaning: মন দিয়ে গড়া (mind-made or constructed by the mind)
figurative_meaning_bn: অসত্য; অলীক; অবাস্তব, কাল্পনিক, বানিয়ে বলা
example_sentences_in_bangla: এসব মনগড়া গল্পে কেউ বিশ্বাস করে না।
example_sentences_in_english: His story is completely made up.
No one believes these fabricated tales.
note: This idiom is widely used in Bengali to dismiss unsubstantiated claims or stories.
